question: Which action was unnecessarily performed and later corrected in exactly one video?

observed_information.statement: The person removes an orange roof piece from a toy truck cab and then appears to re-attach or adjust that roof piece.
The person removes a white cargo box from the truck cab and then places an orange roof piece onto the cab.
The person uses a yellow screwdriver to tighten screws on the front bumper area of the assembled truck cab.
The person inserts a gray interior part into the cabin opening of an orange truck chassis.
The person manipulates a gray roof piece near the truck cabin and then attaches a white block to the rear.
The person attaches a white cargo box to the back of the orange cab.
The person uses a screwdriver to detach the cabin from the truck chassis.
The cabin is re-attached to the chassis while the wheels remain detached on the table.
The person attaches a wheel to the truck chassis, correcting a previous state.
The person aligns a white transport cabin with an orange chassis and presses it into place.
The person detaches the assembled transport cabin and chassis unit from the main assembly.
The person holds the detached cabin and uses a yellow tool to interact with its interior.
The person uses a yellow tool to secure the white cabin back onto the orange chassis.
The person uses a yellow-handled screwdriver to fasten an orange panel onto the top of the cab.

working_relations.statement: v2 and v3 both contain events where a cabin is separated from a chassis and later placed back onto a chassis, but only v3 explicitly names the cabin as a transport cabin.
v1 shows roof removal and rear/cargo manipulation while v3 shows transport cabin/chassis detachment and top-panel attachment, leaving the rear-roof-plus-transport-cabin mapping unresolved.

The three videos distribute the relevant part actions across interior insertion, cabin/chassis detach-and-reattach, and transport-cabin interior interaction, so the option-to-video mapping is not settled by the reports alone.
v1 contains roof and front-bumper events while v2 contains cabin/chassis and wheel-correction events, but neither report explicitly shows a bumper-and-roof detach-and-correction sequence.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the cabin/chassis detach-and-reattach sequence in v2 or v3 is the transport cabin and chassis action and whether it was unnecessary remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v3 explicitly names a transport cabin and chassis and shows detach/re-attach, but the detachment is followed by interior work, while v2 shows cabin/chassis detach/re-attach without naming the cabin as transport cabin or showing the detachment was unnecessary.
